caṇḍī.p: [Caṇḍa+ī] (thī) Google Translate (1) A rough-and-tumble woman. Sanda: (1a) - Look. (2) A woman who is often angry. An angry woman. Pandit - (2) - Look. (3) The woman who will be Pandit.
pn: Caṇḍī 01. One of the chief women supporters of Nārada Buddha. Bv.x.25.
Caṇḍī 02. A name given to the goddess Kāḷakaṇṇī, daughter of Virūpakkha. She was so-called because of her temper. Ja.iii.259.
